scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules build && pnpm run printSuccess
scripts.build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run check && pnpm run compile && pnpm run test && pnpm run packageExecutable && pnpm run printSuccess
scripts.packageExecutable: pnpm --filter . deploy --prod --offline build/release/executable && cd build/release/executable && mv build/compiled/* . && rm -rf build
